title: Tidekeeper's Workshop
provenance: Original Postern rehearsal authored 27 September 2026. Fictional mechanisms; not Wrenmere canon. Difficulty is not human-calibrated.

intro.storyOn: The tidekeeper has left for supper. Behind the workshop, a service gate rests on its stop. Brass fittings, a launch ledger and a stubborn gauge are all you need to reopen the way. Nothing is timed.
intro.storyOff: Raise the service gate. Follow the launch-order record to find the handle, and calibrate the gauge before operating the winch. All numbers describe a fictional demonstration.

ending.storyOn: The handle turns without resistance. The gate rises and the service path is open. You reconciled the written order with the instrument rather than trusting its raw reading.
ending.storyOff: The handle turns without resistance. The gate rises and the service path is open. You reconciled the written order with the instrument rather than trusting its raw reading.

solution.storyOn: The only launch order is Snipe, Heron, Tern, Plover, so enter 9472 at the cabinet. Take the handle and install it on the winch. Both calibration pairs show an additive offset of 3; enter 3 at the gauge. The reading 8 corrects to 5. Set notch 5, route the clutch to Lift, then raise the gate. Handle placement and both settings can be reversed without losing anything.
solution.storyOff: The only launch order is Snipe, Heron, Tern, Plover, so enter 9472 at the cabinet. Take the handle and install it on the winch. Both calibration pairs show an additive offset of 3; enter 3 at the gauge. The reading 8 corrects to 5. Set notch 5, route the clutch to Lift, then raise the gate. Handle placement and both settings can be reversed without losing anything.

text.storyOn: The launches are Snipe, Heron, Tern and Plover. Snipe immediately precedes Heron. Tern is neither first nor last. Plover follows Tern. Rack marks: Snipe 9; Heron 4; Tern 7; Plover 2. The handle cabinet accepts these marks in launch order.
text.storyOff: The launches are Snipe, Heron, Tern and Plover. Snipe immediately precedes Heron. Tern is neither first nor last. Plover follows Tern. Rack marks: Snipe 9; Heron 4; Tern 7; Plover 2. The handle cabinet accepts these marks in launch order.

text.storyOn: This gauge adds the same fixed offset to every true level. Calibration records: true 2 read 5; true 8 read 11. The current raw reading is 8. Enter the offset, not the corrected reading. The winch notch must match the corrected level.
text.storyOff: This gauge adds the same fixed offset to every true level. Calibration records: true 2 read 5; true 8 read 11. The current raw reading is 8. Enter the offset, not the corrected reading. The winch notch must match the corrected level.
